gen-dafont-groovy-gf-duru-sans: Groovy draws funky, loosely spaced letters with arms and legs that never vary in thickness, and its c nearly seals itself shut. Duru Sans opens everything back up, its small letters wide-mouthed and its ascenders barely poking above the line.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-gafata: Groovy leans friendly and funky, its c almost closed and its lowercase loosely spaced. Gafata takes over for the reading, a sans with wide-eyed e shapes that stays easy to follow paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-georama: Loose, bouncy, a bit goofy: Groovy keeps its c nearly shut and its strokes free of any thick-and-thin shift. Georama picks up the text with a wide-open c and capitals that barely rise, so a long passage moves along without any fuss.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-gidole: Gidole reads like glowing neon tubing, every stroke the same, with terminals that hang apart like open scissor blades. Groovy brings the opposite habit up top, its nearly closed c and loose lowercase giving the page a funky front door before Gidole takes over.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-golos-text: Groovy's c nearly closes into a slit, and its lowercase spreads out loosely. Golos Text answers with a plain sans whose lowercase fills the line and whose s opens wide, so a long passage feels approachable and steady.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Funky, loose and friendly, Groovy squeezes its c to a thin slit. Hedvig Letters Sans sits beneath it with a clear gap in each c and small letters that nearly match the capitals, so the two share a page without crowding.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-heebo: Groovy is friendly and funky, with a nearly closed c. Heebo sits underneath with curves that stop short of closing, so if the body gets bigger than the heading, the sans-serif text will start to compete with Groovy's looseness.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-hind-guntur: Groovy's most obvious quirk is a c pinched almost shut, with strokes that never thicken or thin. Hind Guntur counters with wide gaps between curves and stems and lowercase stamped like metal type, giving the page a loose top and a firm base.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-hind-madurai: Friendly Groovy keeps its c nearly closed and its lowercase loosely spaced, with arms and legs that never change width. Make the heading small and Hind Madurai's sans letters, open at both ends of each s, take over the page.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase close to ascender height, with no calligraphic thinning and an a left slightly ajar. Its strongest quality is how openly it contrasts with Groovy's nearly closed letters.
